title: The Basement Cat
lines: Ben heard a movement down in the basement.
For a moment he stood still on the step.
He took a lamp and went down to look.
A small gray cat sat in a box.
He and Mom made an agreement.
The cat can stay if Ben feeds it.
Now it naps on the pavement in the sun.

questions.ask: What did Ben hear at the start?
questions.listenFor: A movement in the basement. Line one says it, and it is what sets the story off.

questions.ask: What was the agreement Ben made with Mom?
questions.listenFor: The cat can stay if Ben feeds it. Two people agree - that is what an agreement is.

questions.ask: Would you have gone down the steps? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what they would have taken with them.
